editorNote: A thin day with no major releases. The most discussed items were about rules and access: a safety bill Anthropic proposed that applies only after large harms, and sites shutting out AI agents. Anthropic also set aside shares for a public benefit fund and gave an outside watchdog deeper access. On the research side, a preprint on reasoning models steering their own chains of thought is worth a look.
